requirements.name: SQL proficiency
requirements.source: - Write SQL queries against our data warehouse to answer questions about sales, stock levels, shrink and supplier performance.

requirements.name: Tableau dashboards
requirements.source: - Build and maintain Tableau dashboards for buyers and distribution center managers.

requirements.name: Demand forecasting
requirements.source: - Support weekly demand forecasts by category and store, and measure forecast accuracy over time.

requirements.name: Out-of-stock and spoilage analysis
requirements.source: - Analyze out-of-stock and spoilage trends, and recommend changes to order quantities and delivery schedules.

requirements.name: Supplier performance reporting
requirements.source: - Prepare monthly reports on supplier fill rates and on-time delivery.

requirements.name: Data cleaning and reconciliation
requirements.source: - Clean and reconcile data from our point-of-sale, warehouse management and supplier systems.

requirements.name: Ad hoc analysis
requirements.source: - Respond to ad hoc analysis requests from merchandising and store operations.

requirements.name: Bachelor's degree
requirements.source: - Bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, business analytics, supply chain, computer science or a related field.

requirements.name: Years of experience
requirements.source: - 1 to 3 years of experience in a data analyst or business analyst role.

requirements.name: Excel skills
requirements.source: - Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables and lookups.

requirements.name: Forecasting methods and statistics
requirements.source: - Familiarity with basic forecasting methods and statistics.

requirements.name: Retail or supply chain analytics experience
requirements.source: - Experience in retail, grocery or supply chain analytics.

requirements.name: Python or R
requirements.source: - Experience with Python or R for data analysis (pandas, tidyverse).

requirements.name: Cloud data warehouse
requirements.source: - Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.
